reason: I already have an installer and I have spoken to a company; I am about to decide. I am not going to start over and wait for new offers from people I don't know through an app that just launched.
objection: Is this app even working? If I download it with my little storage and data and there are only two or three companies in Khartoum on it, I have wasted my time. And I don't know these companies - how do I know the ratings are real if nobody has finished a project yet?
would_change_my_mind: If my son or a neighbour told me they got a cheaper, better written offer through it, or if the free check of my existing quote showed my installer is overcharging me or using weak batteries.
